# Strategic Brief Framework Template

## Problem

[What issue requires strategic attention?]

## Stakes

[Why does this matter now?]

## Insight

[What changes how the problem should be understood?]

## Strategic direction

[Where should the organization move?]

## Mechanism

[How is the idea expected to work?]

## Evidence and uncertainty

[What supports the claim and what remains unknown?]

## Implications

[What this means for choices, resources, stakeholders, or timing]

## Next decision

[What should happen next?]
